# static

**In one sentence:** the whole browser-side app — HTML, JavaScript and CSS shown inside the
desktop window that `plk ui` opens.

## Why it exists
The desktop app is a pywebview window (a small embedded browser) that loads these files.
Everything you see and click — project library, step list, run log, review modals — is
plain ES-module JavaScript here; all real work happens in Python, reached through the
bridge in `prepare_lora_kit_ui/bridge.py`.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The single page: the `#app` window skeleton (library, project view, job panel). Loads `styles.css` and `app.js`. |
| `app.js` | Entry point: installs the error banner, waits for pywebview to be ready, then runs `init` from `core/app.js`. |
| `styles.css` | Imports every stylesheet in order: design kit, `core/foundation.css`, then one file per screen and step. |
| `core/` | Boot sequence, the `api()` handle to the Python bridge (with JSDoc types), DOM helpers, error banner, `foundation.css`. |
| `+state/` | The one shared, mutable `state` object, split into one file per topic. |
| `shell/` | Project-window glue: event binding, `render()`, tab switching. |
| `library/` | Start screen: project card grid with search/sort and New/Edit/Duplicate/Delete dialogs. |
| `project/` | The open project: step and substep list, Metadata tab, what gets sent with a run. |
| `job/` | Starts, polls, cancels and shows a run; routes each "needs input" pause to the right step modal. |
| `settings/` | Settings dialog for machine-wide options (HF cache, hardware, SeedVR2, default models). |
| `components/` | Shared modal layer and the keep/reject review card. |
| `caption/` | The "model loading / elapsed" status line used by job panel and caption modals. |
| `styles/` | The self-contained `nf-*` design kit (tokens + one CSS file per component). |
| `steps/*/` | One folder per step screen: `source_review`, `curate_details`, `bbox_annotation`, `caption_verify`, `vae_review`, `upscale_review`, `bucket_pool_details`, `export_review`, plus `step_config` (pre-run settings form) and `step_help` ("?" help text). |

## How it works
- `app.js` → `core/boot.js` waits for `pywebviewready` → `core/app.js` `init` loads
  projects and shows the library.
- Opening a project renders the step list (`project/`); pressing Run calls the bridge's
  `start_run` and `job/` polls `get_job_status`.
- When a step pauses for a human, the job payload carries a `pending.kind`;
  `job/controller.js` opens the matching `steps/<kind>` modal, and its answer goes back
  through `submit_interaction`.

## Who uses it
- `prepare_lora_kit/cli/ui.py` — `plk ui` opens a pywebview window on `index.html`.
- Tests: `tests/ui/static/*.test.js` (node test runner), including
  `css_overflow.test.js`, which enforces the overflow rules in `AGENTS.md`.

## Good to know
- Keep `core/api.js` JSDoc in sync with `bridge.py` whenever a bridge method or payload
  changes (rule from `AGENTS.md`).
- `steps/` itself has no files of its own, so it has no guide; each step folder does.
